description: This file defines the 'Table' interface in the Spark SQL connector catalog package, representing a logical structured data set with methods for retrieving table metadata such as name, schema, columns, partitioning, properties, capabilities, constraints, and version.

classes.name: Table
classes.description: An interface representing a logical structured data set of a data source, providing methods for metadata access and capabilities.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Returns a meaningful name to identify the table, such as database and table name or file location.

methods.name: id
methods.description: Returns a unique identifier for the table to check if two table objects refer to the same metastore entity.

methods.name: schema
methods.description: Returns the schema of the table; deprecated in favor of 'columns'.

methods.name: columns
methods.description: Returns the columns of the table as an array, derived from the schema.

methods.name: partitioning
methods.description: Returns the physical partitioning of the table as an array of Transform objects.

methods.name: properties
methods.description: Returns a map of table properties.

methods.name: capabilities
methods.description: Returns the set of capabilities supported by the table.

methods.name: constraints
methods.description: Returns the constraints for the table.

methods.name: version
methods.description: Returns the version of the table if versioning is supported.
